title: config: ConfigError variants wrap String instead of source error
description: config.rs ConfigError::Io(String), Parse(String), Validation(String) convert source errors to strings at the point of creation, discarding the original error type. Idiomatic Rust: store the source error (std::io::Error, toml::de::Error) as the variant payload with #[source] / #[from], preserving downcasting and structured display. String wrapping is a common antipattern that makes programmatic error handling impossible.
